name: First Skate
source:
In the glittering expanse of a New York ice rink, Detectives Hwan Seo-jun and Iris Rodriguez share their first date, forming a connection that goes beyond their professional partnership.

[From [url=https://try-froggery.itch.io/first-skate]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
紐約的溜冰場上，冰面閃著光。兩位警探Hwan Seo-jun和艾麗絲．羅德里格斯迎來了第一次約會。兩人之間的情誼，也從此超出了工作搭檔的範疇。

〔摘自[url=https://try-froggery.itch.io/first-skate]itch.io[/url]〕
